purpose: Teach: 菊地/平川/滝沢/小柴/志賀/齊藤/岸田/高崎

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの菊地と話してたな
lines.en: Riku—I saw you talking to Kikuchi from the class next door.
lines.style: Light, probing tone. Direct eye contact. Testing whether he'll deny it or own it. Casual but underneath, genuinely curious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、平川さんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your dad's name is Hirakawa, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a question. Quick, slightly defensive rhythm. Not quite looking at her. Turning it back on her before she can press.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、滝沢秀明出演のドラマ観てたな
lines.en: Riku—I caught you watching that drama with Takizawa Hideaki in it.
lines.style: Knowing smirk in the voice. Slower than before, savoring the catch. Leans slightly on the title, enjoying his discomfort.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、理科で小柴博士のニュートリノ習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You learned about Dr. Koshiba's neutrino research in physics, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Rapid counter-attack. Trying to keep pace, keep deflecting. A little desperate now. Not quite fast enough to outrun her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、国語で志賀直哉の小説読んだな
lines.en: Riku—you read Shiga Naoya's novels in your Japanese class.
lines.style: Relentless. Picking up rhythm and confidence. She's not stopping. Warm but unstoppable. The pleasure of finally being the one asking the questions.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のクラスメート、齊藤さんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your classmate's name was Saito, wasn't it, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter now, almost tired. He's running out of deflections. Still trying, but with less conviction. The pattern is breaking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で岸田首相のニュース見てたな
lines.en: Riku—I know you were watching the news about Prime Minister Kishida in your social studies class.
lines.style: Steady, almost gentle now. She's not mocking anymore. Just stating what she knows. A final piece of the pattern laid bare.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で群馬県高崎観音に行ったろ、桜
lines.en: Your family went to the Takasaki Kannon statue in Gunma, didn't they, Sakura?
lines.style: Last desperate lob. Quieter than before. He knows the game is up. A small, genuine smile underneath the words—almost admitting she's won.
